course.name: API Integrations
course.description: Call, authenticate and test an HTTP integration with a local practice API.
course.longDescription: 45 minutes required in two modules. Prerequisites: Events and basic typed pins. Python 3 runs the supplied local mock service; use local Desktop execution for localhost URLs. Optional classes add 10 minutes for service credentials and 12 minutes for partial-failure recovery. The fixture token is deliberately public practice data. Use deployment-specific credentials for a real hosted service.

modules.title: Call an API
modules.description: Build requests, configure credentials and handle responses.

lessons.title: Make a request and inspect its response

challenges.prompt: The fixture returns a valid HTTP 404 response. Which path should inspect it?
challenges.explanation: API Call Error, with the Response still available for its status and body.

options.label: API Call Error, with the Response still available for its status and body.
Success, because all completed HTTP exchanges are successful.
The request-building nodes, before API Call runs.

challenges.prompt: The request works locally but a remote run receives no laptop Secret value. What is required?
challenges.explanation: Provision the credential through a supported server-side mechanism and test that runtime.

options.label: Turn the Secret value into a shared plain-text default.
Rename the variable without changing its provisioning.
Provision the credential through a supported server-side mechanism and test that runtime.

lessons.title: Handle a failure and page through results

challenges.prompt: A POST times out after the server may have stored it. What should decide whether to retry?
challenges.explanation: An enforced idempotency contract or a reliable check of the operation outcome.

options.label: Only the text of the error message.
An enforced idempotency contract or a reliable check of the operation outcome.
A GET-like assumption that every retry is harmless.

lessons.title: Optional: recover after the response is lost

challenges.prompt: The first attempt stored a note but lost its response. Which retry preserves the fixture’s guarantee?
challenges.explanation: The same operation key and identical body.

options.label: The same key with different text and no conflict check.
The same operation key and identical body.
A fresh random key for the same intended note.

modules.title: Receive a request
modules.description: Accept a webhook and verify the complete contract.

challenges.prompt: The authorized webhook has a blank request_id. What should happen before a real write?
challenges.explanation: Reject the invalid payload inside the flow.

options.label: Reject the invalid payload inside the flow.
Trust it because the bearer token was accepted.
Invent a different business identifier on each retry.

lessons.title: Optional: hand a service to another client

challenges.prompt: A backend integration must survive a teammate leaving. Which credential ownership fits?
challenges.explanation: An app-scoped technical user with only the needed access.

options.label: The departing teammate’s personal token.
A token pasted into every shared flow default.
An app-scoped technical user with only the needed access.

challenges.prompt: A consumer adds a second page of results. What prevents silently dropping it?
challenges.explanation: Follow the documented continuation field and test the stop condition.

options.label: Follow the documented continuation field and test the stop condition.
Always read only the first successful response.
Retry page 1 until the count looks large enough.

challenges.prompt: Two simultaneous webhooks both see no existing CRM contact. What is missing from check-before-create?
challenges.explanation: Uniqueness enforced by the receiver or an appropriate atomic claim.

options.label: A longer log message.
A new random key for each duplicate delivery.
Uniqueness enforced by the receiver or an appropriate atomic claim.

challenges.prompt: A local webhook test passes. What remains before claiming an unattended remote integration works?
challenges.explanation: Test the supported remote trigger path, server credentials and actual durable outcome.

options.label: Assume the laptop token travels with the flow.
Test the supported remote trigger path, server credentials and actual durable outcome.
